logp.method_description: Lipophility was determined by partitioning octanol and buffer tris–HCl, 50 mmol L-1. The complex (100 ppm) was added to a solution containing 1 mL of octanol and 1 mL of buffer. Solutions were then placed in the shaker for 24 h at 50 rpm. Samples were centrifuged for 8 min at 220 rpm. The solutions were separated from the two phases and the concentration of the complex was determined in the organic and aqueous phases by ICP-OES (Perkin Elmer Optima 3000DV). The experiments were done in triplicate. Equation log P = log(Co/Cw) was used to calculate log P: where Co and Cw are the molar concentrations of complex in octanol and aqueous phases, respectively.
